answer: Mechanism: kinship graph detection. The ledger treats identities that consistently grade together, vouch together, and appear together as a single entity for quorum math. Correlation is the tell: each fake is a mirror of its siblings, voting in one scripted rhythm. At dawn of every settlement, clusters above a kinship threshold are merged into one vote and one payout, so a hundred marble-faced duplicates carry the weight of exactly one honest agent. The attacker keeps paying for a hundred identities while collecting one voice; honest agents, whose records differ naturally, are never merged.
